prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman crouching on a seamless white studio floor.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, calm confident expression, direct gaze and natural skin texture. She wears a crisp slightly oversized white button-up shirt, fitted blue denim mini skirt and blue open-toe high heels.
composition_elements: Low-angle full-body pose with knees fully bent, heels grounded, one elbow resting on a knee and one hand gently supporting the chin.
Seamless white backdrop and smooth white floor with soft natural contact shadow.
Preserve shirt volume, denim texture, blue footwear, hair and clean minimalist hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio light with even face exposure, gentle fabric highlights, minimal shadows and refined editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 35mm lens at f/4, full-body sharpness with controlled background separation, realistic skin, denim, cotton and leather texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
